name: Phoenix West
description:
Phoenix West is a beachfront condo resort in Orange Beach offering spacious vacation rentals with direct access to the sugar-white sand of Alabama’s Gulf Coast. Designed for families and larger groups, Phoenix West features 1-, 2-, 3-, and 4-bedroom condos that accommodate up to 14 guests, each with expansive Gulf-front balconies and open living spaces.

Guests enjoy private boardwalk access to the beach, allowing easy transitions between the shoreline and the resort. With panoramic Gulf views,
